queries.dax:
// note: PERCENTILEX.EXC at 0.75 over the one to four French customers a subcategory has in 2022: k is out of range where a subcategory has fewer than three customers (a DAX error: k must lie in 1/(N+1)..N/(N+1))
// expect: error
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    Subcategory[Subcategory],
    TREATAS({2022}, 'Date'[Year]),
    TREATAS({"France"}, Customer[Country]),
    "Customers", [Customers],
    "P75 Exc", PERCENTILEX.EXC(CALCULATETABLE(VALUES(Sales[CustomerKey])), [Sales Amount], 0.75)
)
ORDER BY Subcategory[Subcategory]
